description: This file contains utility functions for handling and manipulating Windows file system paths, such as checking for drive prefixes, skipping drive prefixes, offsetting the first component of a path, and comparing paths in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: int win32_has_dos_drive_prefix(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path starts with a Windows DOS drive prefix (e.g., 'C:').

methods.name: int win32_skip_dos_drive_prefix(char ** path)
methods.description: Skips the DOS drive prefix in a path, advancing the path pointer.

methods.name: int win32_offset_1st_component(const char * path)
methods.description: Calculates the offset to the first component of a path, handling UNC and drive paths.

methods.name: int win32_fspathncmp(const char * a,const char * b,size_t count)
methods.description: Compares two file system paths case-insensitively (or case-sensitively based on 'ignore_case'), up to 'count' characters.

methods.name: int win32_fspathcmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Performs a full comparison of two file system paths case-insensitively.

ctags.name: win32_fspathncmp
ctags.pattern: /^int win32_fspathncmp(const char *a, const char *b, size_t count)$/
